subject.title: Unify iOS chat and voice activity

question: Should iOS remove the dedicated Talk destination and make Chat the single owner of dictation, voice notes, realtime voice, and session-scoped activity presentation?
rationale: This changes a primary navigation model and interaction contract rather than repairing a narrowly defined regression, so source inspection and contributor proof cannot establish product intent.

options.title: Sponsor the unified Chat direction
options.body: Review the linked pull request as the implementation candidate, requiring focused ownership and upgrade checks before merge.

options.title: Narrow to session safety first
options.body: Keep the current Chat and Talk destinations while landing only stale-callback and Live Activity ownership fixes in a smaller change.

options.title: Retain separate surfaces
options.body: Reject removal of the Talk destination and pursue smaller consistency improvements within the existing navigation model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the unified Chat direction
recommendation.body: Review the linked pull request as the implementation candidate, requiring focused ownership and upgrade checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most directly connects this owner to iOS Talk presentation, Live Activities, and recent mobile product work.
